title: 〜にかかわる
meaning: affects (something vital); concerns …; is involved in …
simpleExplanation: 〜にかかわる has two related meanings. (1) "affects something important": 命にかかわる (life-threatening), 信用にかかわる (damages one's credibility). (2) "is involved in / relates to" a field or matter: 教育にかかわる仕事 (work related to education). In sense (1) the noun is something precious, and the tone is serious.
whenUsed: Used in every register, from doctors' explanations to news and business e-mails. Sense (1) is a warning or an appeal to seriousness ("this is no small matter"). Sense (2) is neutral and often appears in job descriptions and self-introductions. Written 関わる or 係わる; kana is common.
formation: N + にかかわる + N (命にかかわる病気)
N + にかかわって / にかかわり (continuative)
Common nouns for sense 1: 命・名誉・信用・将来・存続

examples.ja: これは会社の信用にかかわる問題だ。
examples.reading: これはかいしゃのしんようにかかわるもんだいだ。
examples.en: This is a matter that affects the company's credibility.
examples.note: Sense 1: the company's credibility is at stake. 問題 is the usual noun after it.

examples.ja: 命にかかわる病気ではないので、安心してください。
examples.reading: いのちにかかわるびょうきではないので、あんしんしてください。
examples.en: It is not a life-threatening illness, so please rest assured.
examples.note: 命にかかわる = life-threatening. The negative reassures the listener.

examples.ja: 彼は長年、環境問題にかかわる仕事をしてきた。
examples.reading: かれはながねん、かんきょうもんだいにかかわるしごとをしてきた。
examples.en: For many years he has done work related to environmental issues.
examples.note: Sense 2: simply "related to", with no sense of danger.

examples.ja: これは国の将来にかかわる重大な決定だ。
examples.reading: これはくにのしょうらいにかかわるじゅうだいなけっていだ。
examples.en: This is a grave decision that affects the future of the country.
examples.note: 将来 is one of the standard "vital" nouns.

examples.ja: 彼は学生時代から演劇にかかわってきた。
examples.reading: かれはがくせいじだいからえんげきにかかわってきた。
examples.en: He has been involved in theatre since his student days.
examples.note: Continuative てきた form; sense 2, "involved in".

similarGrammar.difference: Neutral "concerning"; it only says what the topic is, with no sense that something vital is at stake.
Looks similar but means "regardless of" and takes a variable noun (天候・年齢).
"Despite", with an unexpected result. Neither meaning of にかかわる.

commonMistakes.wrong: これは命にかかわらず問題だ。
commonMistakes.right: これは命にかかわる問題だ。
commonMistakes.why: にかかわらず is "regardless of". To say the problem affects lives, use にかかわる before the noun.

commonMistakes.wrong: 天気にかかわる試合は行われる。
commonMistakes.right: 天気にかかわらず試合は行われる。
commonMistakes.why: A variable such as 天気 plus a result that stays the same needs にかかわらず, not にかかわる.

commonMistakes.wrong: 彼は環境問題にかかわる。
commonMistakes.right: 彼は環境問題にかかわっている。
commonMistakes.why: For an ongoing involvement, use the ている form; the plain form sounds like a headline or a future plan.

usageNotes: Sense 1 is a strong phrase: saying 名誉にかかわる signals that someone's honour is genuinely on the line, so it is used for serious situations only.
命にかかわる is a set phrase used in medical and safety contexts; the negative 命にかかわるものではない is a standard reassurance.
In sense 2, かかわる can be replaced by 関係する with almost no change in meaning.
jlptTips: When the noun before the blank is 命・信用・名誉・将来 and the following noun is 問題・病気・事態, the answer is にかかわる.
The key distractor is にかかわらず. Check the ending: a rule that holds "whatever X is" wants にかかわらず; a serious effect wants にかかわる.
In 並べ替え, にかかわる is normally followed directly by a noun such as 問題 or 仕事.
